description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class named UserDao for managing User entities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class provides methods for CRUD operations, user search, role management, and other user-related database interactions.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for performing database operations related to User entities, including searching, retrieving, saving, and logically deleting users, as well as role management.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Persists a User entity to the database and returns the saved User.

methods.name: isExistingSystemUser
methods.description: Checks if a UserCredential corresponds to an existing system User with a non-null password.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by user ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingSystemUserIds
methods.description: Returns array of user IDs that exist and are not deleted among provided IDs.

methods.name: getSystemUserIdList
methods.description: Fetches a list of all system user IDs that are active (not deleted).

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on Users by setting their 'deleted' flag to true for given IDs.

methods.name: getAssignableUserRoles
methods.description: Retrieves roles that are marked as assignable, ordered by name.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Fetches a UserRole entity based on role name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Users matching the specified search filter parameters.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Returns an array of User entities matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchUserPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and configures a Paginator object to fetch paginated user search results based on filters.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees associated with a specific user role, with options to include inactive or terminated employees.

methods.name: isUserNameExistByUserName
methods.description: Checks if a username already exists in the system, optionally excluding a specific user ID.

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a User entity based on username.

methods.name: getDefaultAdminUser
methods.description: Retrieves the default admin User, which has no creator and a non-null password.
